The work is not finished. I committed a work-in-progress pass, but `boa_engine` does not compile at this commit, so it is not ready for review.

**Commit:** `a1e7dc3c [BOA-417] WIP: add evaluation handles for cancellable evaluations`
- Adds `core/engine/src/evaluation.rs` with `EvaluationHandle` (`new`, `child`, `cancel`, `is_cancelled`) and a doctest.
- Adds `EngineError::Cancelled` and its erased counterpart in `error/mod.rs`.
- Adds `pub mod evaluation;` in `lib.rs`.
- Adds the `Context` field, `eval_with_evaluation`, and `run_jobs_with_evaluation` in `context/mod.rs`.
- The trailer is `Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.

**Clippy:** `cargo clippy -p boa_engine --all-targets` fails. Its last output line is `warning: build failed, waiting for other jobs to finish...`. The errors are:
- `enter_evaluations` is not defined on `Context`.
- `evaluate_with_evaluation` is not defined on `Script`.

**Still to write:**
- `context/mod.rs`: the private `enter_evaluations`, `check_evaluations`, and `is_evaluation_cancelled` helpers.
- `script.rs`: `Script::evaluate_with_evaluation`.
- `module/mod.rs`: `evaluate_with_evaluation` and `load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation`.
- `vm/mod.rs`: a checkpoint at the top of `check_runtime_limits`.
- `vm/opcode/iteration/loop_ops.rs`: a checkpoint in `IncrementLoopIteration`.
- `job.rs`: the `JobExecutor::run_jobs_with_evaluation` default and the `SimpleJobExecutor` changes. Each queued job records the evaluations active when it was enqueued. Cancelled jobs are skipped without clearing the queue.

**Not done:**
- No tests have been run, including the `evaluation.rs` doctest. The brief forbids test-file changes, so I did not add tests to the repo.
- Plan step 8 (repo tests) is skipped for that reason.
- I did not send the `ask_user` review request, because there is nothing ready to review yet.

If you want this finished in this session, I can write the remaining pieces, get the build and doctests green, and then send the review request.

data.message:
[TESTEM-417] guard mocha adapter emits once testem aborts

Check Testem.aborted before every test event emit, including the
deferred test-end callback, and make all-test-results fire exactly
once even after an abort.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

data.text:
Committed the Mocha adapter guards as `b3da464` on `master`. Jasmine2 and QUnit are not done, so this is a partial pass.

**What changed in `public/testem/mocha_adapter.js`:**
- `tests-start`, `test-result` (from `testPass`, `testFail` and `testPending`) are skipped when `typeof Testem !== 'undefined' && Testem.aborted`. This includes the deferred `_setTimeout` callback.
- `all-test-results` goes through a `signalAllResults()` helper with an `allResultsSent` flag. It fires at most once, and the abort check is deliberately not applied to it, so the completion signal still arrives after an abort.
- `Testem` is added to the `/* globals */` line.

**Checks run:**
- `npx eslint public/testem/mocha_adapter.js`: exit 0.
- Syntax check of the adapter: `mocha adapter syntax ok`.
- Required `lib/app.js` syntax check, last non-empty line: `TESTEM syntax check complete`.

**Not done:**
- `jasmine2_adapter.js` and `qunit_adapter.js` have no guards yet. QUnit queue clearing also still needs the QUnit API checked for the version the repo uses.
- `jasmine_adapter.js` (Jasmine 1) is untouched. You did not name it, so I left it alone. Tell me whether to apply the same guards.
- I did not run the full Mocha suite for this commit (baseline is 492 passing, 3 pending, 8 pre-existing failures). I also did not run a vm-sandbox check of the adapter's behavior with a stubbed `emit`, so the abort paths are verified only by reading the code.
- No browser run has been done, so the browser path is still unverified end to end.

Working tree is clean. I stopped here as you asked. Say the word and I'll do the Jasmine2 and QUnit guards next.
